'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Christopher Claßen LS This Is Getting Out Of Hand''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Christopher Claßen]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Christopher Claßen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
